aiMetadata.description: Set a Discourse user account to a specific trust level, identified by the numeric user ID. Use when an agent needs to promote or demote a member to control their permissions. Because it sets an absolute target level rather than incrementing, repeating the same call leaves the user at the same level.

website_url.description: URL of the discourse url i.e https://discourse.yourinstance.com

users.description: List of users to add to the group

aiMetadata.description: Add one or more users (by username) as members of a Discourse group, identified by its numeric group ID. Use when an agent needs to grant group membership. Re-adding users who are already members has no additional effect, so the call is effectively idempotent.
